CustomField.label: Comparison Query
CustomField.description: The second SOQL query. Used when "Expected Value Comes From" is "Comparison query", for a "Compare two queries" check, or as the list source for the "List contains any" / "List contains none" operators. Supports merge tokens like {!record.Id} and {!record.FieldApiName}. Read a specific column from it with "Comparison Query Field".
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The second SOQL query - for "Comparison query" comparisons, "Compare two queries" checks, or the list for "List contains any"/"List contains none".
